Synthetic format-1 capture, no player data. Both client and server have 1,000 units and tail means of 25 ms (slowest ten) and 100 ms (slowest one). One possible population is 990 units of 10 ms, nine of 16⅔ ms and one of 100 ms. Expected FPS lows are 40 and 10; work-based TPS capacity is capped at 20, giving lows of 20 and 10. The fixture has no health samples: lows must come from its timing summary, not from per-second statistics.
